--!strict
-- A behaviour declaring a field of every Field kind, so the Scripting scene can override each one (Script.Fields) and
-- the Api suites can read them back through the instance and the Script component proxy.
export type Probe = ScriptInstance & {
	Speed: number,
	Count: number,
	Enabled: boolean,
	Title: string,
	Offset: vector,
	Tint: Color,
	Facing: Quat,
	Target: Entity?,
	Clip: AssetRef?,
	Mode: string,
	Waypoints: { number },
	Created: boolean,
	Starts: number,
	Steps: number,
}

local Probe = {}

Probe.Fields = {
	Speed = Field.Number(1.5, { Min = 0, Max = 10, Step = 0.5, Tooltip = "Metres per second" }),
	Count = Field.Integer(3, { Min = 0, Max = 100 }),
	Enabled = Field.Bool(false),
	Title = Field.String("Probe", { Tooltip = "A display name" }),
	Offset = Field.Vector(vector.create(0, 1, 0)),
	Tint = Field.Color(Color.New(1, 0.5, 0.25)),
	Facing = Field.Quat(Quat.Identity()),
	Target = Field.Entity(),
	Clip = Field.Asset("AudioClip"),
	Mode = Field.Enum({ "Idle", "Patrol", "Chase" }, "Patrol"),
	Waypoints = Field.Array(Field.Number()),
}

function Probe.OnCreate(self: Probe)
	self.Created = true
	self.Starts = 0
	self.Steps = 0
end

function Probe.OnStart(self: Probe)
	self.Starts += 1
end

function Probe.OnFixedUpdate(self: Probe, dt: number)
	self.Steps += 1
end

return Script.Define("Probe", Probe)

--!strict
-- Shared helpers of the Api suites (Scripting.scene).
local Support = {}

-- The entity named `name` in the running scene; a missing one fails the calling case.
function Support.Find(name: string): Entity
	local entity = Scene.FindByName(name)
	if entity == nil then
		error(name .. " is not in the scene", 2)
	end
	return entity
end

-- Rounds a number to float, the precision of reflected float fields.
function Support.F32(value: number): number
	local scratch = buffer.create(4)
	buffer.writef32(scratch, 0, value)
	return buffer.readf32(scratch, 0)
end

-- Reads `field` of a component proxy, writes `value` through it and expects to read `value` back (within `epsilon` for
-- numbers and vectors when given). Returns the value read before the write.
function Support.RoundTrip(proxy: any, field: string, value: any, epsilon: number?): any
	local before = proxy[field]
	proxy[field] = value
	local after = proxy[field]
	if epsilon ~= nil then
		Test.ExpectNear(after, value, epsilon, field .. " reads back what was written")
	else
		Test.ExpectEqual(after, value, field .. " reads back what was written")
	end
	return before
end

-- Expects two quaternions to have equal components within `epsilon`.
function Support.ExpectQuatNear(actual: Quat, expected: Quat, epsilon: number, message: string)
	Test.ExpectNear(vector.create(actual.x, actual.y, actual.z), vector.create(expected.x, expected.y, expected.z), epsilon, message)
	Test.ExpectNear(actual.w, expected.w, epsilon, message)
end

-- Expects two colours to have equal channels within `epsilon`.
function Support.ExpectColorNear(actual: Color, expected: Color, epsilon: number, message: string)
	Test.ExpectNear(vector.create(actual.r, actual.g, actual.b), vector.create(expected.r, expected.g, expected.b), epsilon, message)
	Test.ExpectNear(actual.a, expected.a, epsilon, message)
end

return Support

--!strict
-- The Application module (§11.5). Application.Quit is exercised by the QuitApp suite, whose ExpectQuit accepts it.
return Test.Suite("Api.Application", function()
	Test.Case("the application reports its identity, focus and mode", function()
		local editor = Application.IsEditor()
		Test.ExpectEqual(type(editor), "boolean")
		Test.ExpectEqual(type(Application.IsHeadless()), "boolean")
		Test.ExpectEqual(type(Application.IsFocused()), "boolean")
		local platform = Application.GetPlatform()
		Test.Expect(platform == "Windows" or platform == "Linux" or platform == "macOS", "a known platform: " .. platform)
		Test.Expect(string.match(Application.GetVersion(), "^%d+%.%d+%.%d+") ~= nil, "a semantic version: " .. Application.GetVersion())
		-- A test runs with the same answers on every call of the session.
		Test.ExpectEqual(Application.IsEditor(), editor)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Application.GetPlatform(), platform)
	end)

	Test.Case("a test session's view is the project's window size", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Application.GetWindowSize(), vector.create(1280, 720, 0))
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The Assets module (§11.5): references by path and by handle, their paths and types, and missing references.
return Test.Suite("Api.Assets", function()
	Test.Case("assets load by path and by handle and report their path and type", function()
		local clip = Assets.Load("Assets/Audio/Beep.sfx")
		Test.Expect(clip ~= nil and Assets.IsValid(clip), "the sound effect loads")
		local path = Assets.GetPath(clip :: AssetRef)
		Test.ExpectEqual(path, "Assets/Audio/Beep.sfx")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetType(clip :: AssetRef), "AudioClip")
		local script = Assets.Load("Assets/Scripts/Api/Probe.luau") :: AssetRef
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetType(script), "Script")
		local cube = Assets.Load("engine://Meshes/Cube") :: AssetRef
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetType(cube), "Mesh")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetPath(cube), "engine://Meshes/Cube")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetType(Assets.Load("Assets/Scenes/Scripting.scene") :: AssetRef), "Scene")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetType(Assets.Load("engine://Materials/Default") :: AssetRef), "Material")
	end)

	Test.Case("a handle names the same asset as its path", function()
		local speaker = Scene.FindByName("Speaker") :: Entity
		local clip = (speaker.AudioSource :: AudioSource).Clip :: AssetRef
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.GetPath(clip), "Assets/Audio/Beep.sfx")
		local probe = (Scene.FindByName("Probe") :: Entity):GetComponent("Script") :: Script
		local script = probe.Script :: AssetRef
		local byPath = Assets.Load(Assets.GetPath(script))
		Test.ExpectEqual(byPath, script)
	end)

	Test.Case("missing references are nil and not valid", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.Load("Assets/Tests/Api/Missing.sfx"), nil)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.Load("fedcba9876543210"), nil)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Assets.IsValid(nil), false)
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- AssetRef values (§11.5): references to the same asset compare equal by handle and are one table key.
return Test.Suite("Api.AssetRef", function()
	Test.Case("two references to one asset are equal and others are not", function()
		local a = Assets.Load("Assets/Audio/Beep.sfx") :: AssetRef
		local b = Assets.Load("Assets/Audio/Beep.sfx") :: AssetRef
		local cube = Assets.Load("engine://Meshes/Cube") :: AssetRef
		Test.Expect(a == b, "the same asset")
		Test.Expect(a ~= cube, "different assets")
		Test.Expect(not (cube == a), "equality is symmetric")
		local seen: { [AssetRef]: boolean } = { [a] = true }
		Test.Expect(seen[b] == true, "one asset is one table key")
		Test.ExpectEqual(seen[cube], nil)
		local speaker = Scene.FindByName("Speaker") :: Entity
		Test.Expect((speaker.AudioSource :: AudioSource).Clip == a, "a component's reference equals a loaded one")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The Audio module (§10.2, §11.5): the session's group mix and one-shots in every group, heard through
-- Test.CaptureAudio (deterministic: the session pulls 750 frames per tick at 64 Hz).
local GROUPS: { AudioGroup } = { "Music", "Sfx", "Ui" }

return Test.Suite("Api.Audio", function()
	Test.Case("every group starts at full volume and keeps the volume a script sets", function()
		for _, group in GROUPS do
			Test.ExpectEqual(Audio.GetGroupVolume(group), 1, group .. " starts at 1")
		end
		Audio.SetGroupVolume("Music", 0.5)
		Audio.SetGroupVolume("Sfx", 0.25)
		Audio.SetGroupVolume("Ui", 2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Audio.GetGroupVolume("Music"), 0.5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Audio.GetGroupVolume("Sfx"), 0.25)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Audio.GetGroupVolume("Ui"), 2)
		Test.Expect(not pcall(Audio.SetGroupVolume, "Sfx", -1), "a negative volume is refused")
		for _, group in GROUPS do
			Audio.SetGroupVolume(group, 1)
		end
	end)

	Test.Case("one-shots play in every group and are heard", function()
		local clip = Assets.Load("Assets/Audio/Beep.sfx") :: AssetRef
		local silence = Test.CaptureAudio(2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(silence.Peak, 0, "nothing plays before the one-shots")
		Audio.PlayOneShot(clip)
		Audio.PlayOneShot(clip, vector.create(0, 3, 10), 0.5, "Music")
		Audio.PlayOneShot(clip, nil, 0.75, "Sfx")
		Audio.PlayOneShot(clip, nil, 1, "Ui")
		local levels = Test.CaptureAudio(4)
		Test.Expect(levels.Peak > 0 and levels.RmsLeft > 0 and levels.RmsRight > 0, "the one-shots are heard")
		Audio.SetGroupVolume("Music", 0)
		Audio.SetGroupVolume("Sfx", 0)
		Audio.SetGroupVolume("Ui", 0)
		Audio.PlayOneShot(clip, nil, 1, "Ui")
		local muted = Test.CaptureAudio(4)
		Test.Expect(muted.Peak < levels.Peak, "muted groups are quieter")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The AudioListener proxy: its one field read and written.
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.AudioListener", function()
	Test.Case("Primary reads and writes through the proxy", function()
		local listener = Support.Find("Camera").AudioListener :: AudioListener
		Test.ExpectEqual(listener.Primary, true, "the camera's listener is primary")
		Support.RoundTrip(listener, "Primary", false)
		Support.RoundTrip(listener, "Primary", true)
		local added = Scene.CreateEntity("SecondEar"):AddComponent("AudioListener", { Primary = false }) :: AudioListener
		Test.ExpectEqual(added.Primary, false)
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The AudioSource proxy (§10.2, §11.5): playback control and every field read and written.
local Support = require("./Support")

local ATTENUATIONS: { Attenuation } = { "None", "Inverse", "Linear", "Exponential" }
local GROUPS: { AudioGroup } = { "Music", "Sfx", "Ui" }

return Test.Suite("Api.AudioSource", function()
	Test.Case("a source plays, pauses, resumes and stops its clip", function()
		local source = Support.Find("Speaker").AudioSource :: AudioSource
		Test.ExpectEqual(source:IsPlaying(), false, "PlayOnStart is off")
		source:Play()
		Test.ExpectEqual(source:IsPlaying(), true)
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(source:IsPlaying(), true, "still playing a tick later")
		source:Pause()
		Test.ExpectEqual(source:IsPlaying(), false, "a paused voice is not playing")
		source:Resume()
		Test.ExpectEqual(source:IsPlaying(), true)
		source:Stop()
		Test.ExpectEqual(source:IsPlaying(), false)
		source.Loop = true
		source:Play()
		Test.WaitTicks(40)
		Test.ExpectEqual(source:IsPlaying(), true, "a looping clip keeps playing past its end")
		source:Stop()
	end)

	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy", function()
		local source = Support.Find("Speaker").AudioSource :: AudioSource
		local clip = Assets.Load("Assets/Audio/Beep.sfx") :: AssetRef
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(source, "Clip", clip), clip, "the scene assigns the beep")
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(source, "Volume", 0.25, 1e-6), 0.8, 1e-6, "the scene's volume")
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "Pitch", 1.5, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "Loop", true)
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "PlayOnStart", true)
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "Spatial", false)
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "MinDistance", 2, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "MaxDistance", 30, 1e-6)
		for _, attenuation in ATTENUATIONS do
			Support.RoundTrip(source, "Attenuation", attenuation)
		end
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "Rolloff", 0.5, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "DopplerFactor", 0, 1e-6)
		for _, group in GROUPS do
			Support.RoundTrip(source, "Group", group)
		end
		Support.RoundTrip(source, "Clip", nil)
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			source.Volume = -1
		end), "a volume below its minimum is refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The BoxCollider proxy: every field read and written, and a resized box changes the body's bounds.
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.BoxCollider", function()
	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy and reshapes the body", function()
		local crate = Support.Find("Crate")
		local box = crate.BoxCollider :: BoxCollider
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(box, "HalfExtents", vector.create(0.5, 0.25, 0.75)), vector.create(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(box, "Offset", vector.create(0, 0.25, 0)), vector.zero)
		local rotation = Quat.AngleAxis(30, vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		local previous = box.Rotation
		box.Rotation = rotation
		Support.ExpectQuatNear(box.Rotation, rotation, 1e-6, "Rotation reads back what was written")
		Support.ExpectQuatNear(previous, Quat.Identity(), 0, "the default rotation")
		box.Rotation = Quat.Identity()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(box, "IsTrigger", true), false)
		box.IsTrigger = false
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local minimum, maximum = Physics.GetColliderBounds(crate)
		Test.Expect(minimum ~= nil and maximum ~= nil, "the reshaped collider has bounds")
		local size = (maximum :: vector) - (minimum :: vector)
		Test.ExpectNear(size, vector.create(1, 0.5, 1.5), 0.01, "the body uses the new half extents")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			box.HalfExtents = vector.create(0, 1, 1)
		end), "half extents below 1 mm are refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The Camera proxy (§4.3, §11.5): screen rays and screen points in the session's 1280 x 720 view, in both projections,
-- and every field read and written.
local Support = require("./Support")

local CENTER_X, CENTER_Y = 639.5, 359.5

return Test.Suite("Api.Camera", function()
	Test.Case("the view center ray follows the camera and points project back to the center", function()
		local entity = Support.Find("Camera")
		local camera = entity.Camera :: Camera
		-- Rays use the rendered camera pose, so let one frame render first.
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local origin, direction = camera:ScreenToWorldRay(CENTER_X, CENTER_Y)
		Test.ExpectNear(origin, entity.Transform.WorldPosition, 0.0001, "a perspective ray starts at the camera")
		Test.ExpectNear(direction, entity.Transform:Forward(), 0.0001, "and runs along its forward axis")
		local ahead = entity.Transform.WorldPosition + entity.Transform:Forward() * 5
		local screen = camera:WorldToScreen(ahead)
		Test.ExpectNear(vector.create(screen.x, screen.y, 0), vector.create(CENTER_X, CENTER_Y, 0), 0.01)
		Test.ExpectNear(screen.z, camera.NearClip / 5, 0.0001, "reverse-Z depth")
		local _, corner = camera:ScreenToWorldRay(0.5, 0.5)
		Test.Expect(vector.dot(corner, entity.Transform:Right()) < 0 and vector.dot(corner, entity.Transform:Up()) > 0, "the top-left pixel looks up and left")
		camera.Projection = "Orthographic"
		local orthoOrigin, orthoDirection = camera:ScreenToWorldRay(CENTER_X, CENTER_Y)
		Test.ExpectNear(orthoDirection, entity.Transform:Forward(), 0.0001, "orthographic rays are parallel")
		Test.ExpectNear(orthoOrigin, entity.Transform.WorldPosition + entity.Transform:Forward() * camera.NearClip, 0.0001)
		camera.Projection = "Perspective"
	end)

	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy", function()
		local camera = Support.Find("Camera").Camera :: Camera
		for _, projection: ProjectionType in { "Orthographic", "Perspective" } do
			Support.RoundTrip(camera, "Projection", projection)
		end
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(camera, "VerticalFov", 70, 1e-5), 50, 1e-5, "the scene's field of view")
		Support.RoundTrip(camera, "OrthographicSize", 6, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(camera, "NearClip", 0.5, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(camera, "FarClip", 250, 1e-4)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(camera, "Primary", false), true)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Scene.GetPrimaryCamera(), nil, "no primary camera is left")
		camera.Primary = true
		for _, clear: ClearMode in { "Color", "Skybox" } do
			Support.RoundTrip(camera, "Clear", clear)
		end
		local color = Color.New(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)
		camera.ClearColor = color
		Support.ExpectColorNear(camera.ClearColor, color, 1e-6, "ClearColor reads back what was written")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			camera.VerticalFov = 0
		end), "a field of view below 1 degree is refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The CapsuleCollider proxy: every field read and written, and the resized capsule's bounds.
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.CapsuleCollider", function()
	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy and reshapes the body", function()
		local pole = Support.Find("Pole")
		local capsule = pole.CapsuleCollider :: CapsuleCollider
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(capsule, "Radius", 0.3, 1e-6), 0.2, 1e-6, "the scene's radius")
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(capsule, "HalfHeight", 1, 1e-6), 0.8, 1e-6, "the scene's half height")
		Support.RoundTrip(capsule, "Offset", vector.create(0, 0.5, 0))
		local tilt = Quat.FromEuler(0, 0, 90)
		capsule.Rotation = tilt
		Support.ExpectQuatNear(capsule.Rotation, tilt, 1e-6, "Rotation reads back what was written")
		capsule.Rotation = Quat.Identity()
		Support.RoundTrip(capsule, "IsTrigger", true)
		capsule.IsTrigger = false
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local minimum, maximum = Physics.GetColliderBounds(pole)
		Test.Expect(minimum ~= nil and maximum ~= nil, "the reshaped capsule has bounds")
		Test.ExpectNear((maximum :: vector) - (minimum :: vector), vector.create(0.6, 2.6, 0.6), 0.01, "radius and half height")
		Test.ExpectNear(((maximum :: vector) + (minimum :: vector)) * 0.5, vector.create(6, 1.5, -2), 0.01, "the offset")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The CharacterController proxy (§9.6, §11.5): a character settles on the ground, moves at the velocity it is given,
-- and every field reads and writes.
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.CharacterController", function()
	Test.Case("a character stands on the ground and walks at the requested velocity", function()
		local hero = Support.Find("Hero")
		local character = hero.CharacterController :: CharacterController
		Test.WaitUntil(function(): boolean
			return character:IsGrounded()
		end, 120)
		Test.ExpectNear(character:GetGroundNormal(), vector.create(0, 1, 0), 0.001, "flat ground")
		local start = hero.Transform.WorldPosition
		for _ = 1, 16 do
			character:Move(vector.create(2, 0, 0))
			Test.WaitTicks(1)
		end
		Test.ExpectNear(character:GetVelocity().x, 2, 0.01, "the character walks at 2 m/s")
		local moved = hero.Transform.WorldPosition - start
		Test.ExpectNear(moved.x, 2 * 16 / 64, 0.05, "16 steps at 2 m/s")
		Test.ExpectNear(moved.z, 0, 0.001)
		Test.Expect(character:IsGrounded(), "still on the ground")
	end)

	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy", function()
		local character = Support.Find("Hero").CharacterController :: CharacterController
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(character, "Height", 1.6, 1e-6), 1.8, 1e-6, "the default height")
		Support.RoundTrip(character, "Radius", 0.35, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(character, "MaxSlopeAngle", 30, 1e-5)
		Support.RoundTrip(character, "StepHeight", 0.2, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(character, "Mass", 80, 1e-5)
		Support.RoundTrip(character, "GravityFactor", 0.5, 1e-6)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(character, "Layer", "Character"), "Default")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The Color type (§11.5): constructors, interpolation, channels and exact equality.
return Test.Suite("Api.Color", function()
	Test.Case("colors are built from channels and hex, interpolate and compare exactly", function()
		local c = Color.New(1, 2, 3)
		Test.Expect(c.r == 1 and c.g == 2 and c.b == 3 and c.a == 1, "alpha defaults to one; HDR channels are kept")
		c.r = 0.5
		c.g = 0.25
		c.b = 0
		c.a = 0.5
		Test.Expect(c.r == 0.5 and c.g == 0.25 and c.b == 0 and c.a == 0.5, "channels are writable")
		local half = Color.Lerp(Color.New(0, 0, 0, 0), Color.New(1, 2, 4, 1), 0.5)
		Test.Expect(half == Color.New(0.5, 1, 2, 0.5), "lerp interpolates every channel")
		Test.Expect(Color.Lerp(c, half, 2) == half, "t is clamped to one")
		local hex = Color.FromHex("#ff8000")
		Test.ExpectEqual(hex.r, 1)
		Test.ExpectNear(hex.g, 128 / 255, 1e-7)
		Test.ExpectEqual(hex.b, 0)
		Test.ExpectEqual(hex.a, 1)
		Test.ExpectNear(Color.FromHex("#00000040").a, 64 / 255, 1e-7)
		Test.Expect(Color.New(1, 0, 0) == Color.FromHex("#FF0000"), "equal channels compare equal")
		Test.Expect(Color.New(1, 0, 0) ~= Color.New(1, 0, 0, 0.5), "alpha takes part in equality")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(Color.FromHex, "#12345"), "malformed hex is refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The Debug module (§11.5): every primitive draws without error, with and without its optional arguments, and
-- Debug.Break is a counted no-op in test runs, in every mode.
return Test.Suite("Api.Debug", function()
	Test.Case("every debug primitive draws with and without its options", function()
		local a, b = vector.create(-1, 1, 0), vector.create(1, 2, 0)
		local color = Color.New(0.2, 0.8, 0.4, 0.5)
		Debug.DrawLine(a, b)
		Debug.DrawLine(a, b, color, 1)
		Debug.DrawRay(a, vector.create(0, 2, 0))
		Debug.DrawRay(a, vector.create(0, 0, -3), color, 0.5)
		Debug.DrawBox(b, vector.create(0.5, 0.25, 0.5))
		Debug.DrawBox(b, vector.one, Quat.FromEuler(0, 45, 0), color, 2)
		Debug.DrawSphere(a, 0.5)
		Debug.DrawSphere(a, 1, color, 0.25)
		Debug.DrawArrow(a, b)
		Debug.DrawArrow(b, a, color, 1)
		Debug.DrawText(b, "FeatureTest")
		Debug.DrawText(a, "Debug ✓", color, 3)
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			Debug.DrawSphere(a, 0)
		end), "a zero radius is refused")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			Debug.DrawRay(a, vector.zero)
		end), "a zero ray is refused")
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
	end)

	Test.Case("Debug.Break does not pause a test run", function()
		local tick = Time.GetTick()
		Debug.Break()
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetTick(), tick + 2, "time keeps running after a break")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The DirectionalLight proxy: every field read and written.
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.DirectionalLight", function()
	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy", function()
		local light = Support.Find("Sun").DirectionalLight :: DirectionalLight
		local color = Color.New(1, 0.9, 0.7)
		local white = light.Color
		light.Color = color
		Support.ExpectColorNear(light.Color, color, 1e-6, "Color reads back what was written")
		Support.ExpectColorNear(white, Color.New(1, 1, 1), 0, "the default colour")
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(light, "Intensity", 5, 1e-6), 3, 1e-6, "the scene's intensity")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(light, "CastShadows", true), false, "the scene's sun casts no shadow")
		Support.RoundTrip(light, "ShadowDistance", 60, 1e-5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(light, "CascadeCount", 2), 4)

--!strict
-- The Time module (§4.2, §11.5) in a lockstep test session at 64 Hz: ticks, simulation time, the phase-aware delta and
-- alpha, frames, the time scale and the non-deterministic real time. The Timing suite covers scripted clocks.
local FIXED = 1 / 64

return Test.Suite("Api.Time", function()
	Test.Case("simulation time counts ticks of the project's fixed rate", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetFixedDeltaTime(), FIXED)
		local tick = Time.GetTick()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetTime(), tick * FIXED)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetDeltaTime(), FIXED, "a case runs in the fixed phase")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetInterpolationAlpha(), 1, "alpha is 1 in the fixed phase")
		local frame = Time.GetFrameCount()
		Test.WaitTicks(4)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetTick(), tick + 4)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetTime(), (tick + 4) * FIXED)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetFrameCount(), frame + 4, "lockstep renders one frame per tick")
	end)

	Test.Case("the time scale is kept by the session and never stretches a fixed step", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetTimeScale(), 1)
		Time.SetTimeScale(0.5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetTimeScale(), 0.5)
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetDeltaTime(), FIXED, "a fixed step never stretches; the scale sets how many steps a frame runs")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Time.GetFixedDeltaTime(), FIXED, "the fixed delta is unscaled")
		Time.SetTimeScale(1)
		Test.Expect(not pcall(Time.SetTimeScale, -1), "a negative scale is refused")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(Time.SetTimeScale, 101), "a scale above 100 is refused")
	end)

	Test.Case("real time is a finite number that never runs backwards", function()
		local first = Time.GetRealTime()
		local second = Time.GetRealTime()
		Test.Expect(first == first and math.abs(first) < math.huge, "finite")
		Test.Expect(second >= first, "monotonic")
	end)
end)
